items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Because what I know, I've talked to the older musicians and taped their stories, and they would remember things from when Almond was, before Almond was born. [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: Well, as Dick knows, he, once again, I say this goes back into a technical part of the history of jazz, which has always been very...
Because what I know, I've talked to the older musicians and taped their stories, and they would remember things from when Almond was, before Almond was born.
